messages:
Maria (Support): FYI galileo reporting sudden spike -> lots of 429s for dedicated pool A, customer says latency shot up to 1.2s per token and they saw billing anomalies. escalating.
support-bot: Alert: Admission control engaged for pool 'dedicated-A' (burst credits exhausted). Link: https://console.redwood/prod/pools/dedicated-A/alerts
Maria (Support): repro steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/generate with model=rw-opt-8k-quant 2) ~5000 concurrent connections 3) payloads have long contexts (~2k tokens). They say it started after a campaign push.
Maria (Support): quick curl they provided: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"model":"rw-opt-8k-quant","prompt":"<...>","max_tokens":1024}'``` response: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Sachin (Infra): can you paste the pool admission_control logs (tail) and the /metrics snapshot? need to see token/sec, queue depth, and burst_credit balance.
Maria (Support): pasted (sanitized): ```[admission] time=16:12:07 pool=dedicated-A token_rate=14500 tps_limit=12000 burst_credits=0 queue=320 dropped=54``` more: `autoscaler: target_replicas=12 current=10 gpu_util=88%`
Alex (SRE): noisy neighbor? GPU util 88% + queue 320 sounds like sustained high usage, not a tiny spike. Which model variants are hot?
Sachin (Infra): checking tenant telemetry — galileo's tenant_id=tn-gal-81 shows token_rate=11k but there are a few tenants at 2k-3k each. Looks like combined burst pushed pool over headroom. Also some long-seq KVs causing KV cache pressure.
Jess (CS): customer is worried about billing because they got charged for failed requests. any quick mitigations?
Alex (SRE): short term: 1) enable emergency burst refill for tn-gal-81 (grant +30s worth of credits) 2) route their traffic to standby pool B (if compatible model) as fallback 3) set transient reject for very long contexts (>3k tokens) with 400/validation message. Need ops ok.
Sachin (Infra): I can do (1) and (2) now. For longer term: re-evaluate autoscaler policy (scale more aggressively when queue>100), increase headroom to 25% for dedicated-A, and add per-tenant soft limits to avoid single tenant draining burst pool.
Maria (Support): on (1) and (2) please post exact commands so I can update customer.
Sachin (Infra): command to refill credits: ```rbctl pools refill-burst --pool dedicated-A --tenant tn-gal-81 --amount 30000``` (amount in token credits). Fallback route: `rbctl routing add --pool dedicated-B --tenant tn-gal-81 --models rw-opt-8k-quant:rw-opt-8k-quant-v2 --priority=high --ttl=300`
Alex (SRE): also add admission_control tweak: change policy from `queue_threshold=200` to `queue_threshold=100` and `scale_on_queue=true` so autoscaler triggers earlier. We'll coordinate change window.
Jess (CS): I'll tell galileo we can do an emergency refill + route to standby now, and propose longer term headroom plan. keep me posted on timeline. :thumbsup:
Maria (Support): customer asked for a writeup on how burst credits are sized. Any calc we can send?
Sachin (Infra): suggested sizing note (short): `baseline_tps = committed_replicas * per_replica_tps; recommended_burst = baseline_tps * multiplier * window_seconds` e.g. multiplier=2, window=300s => gives 2.5M token credits for a 10k baseline. Also recommend setting per-tenant max_burst to avoid pool exhaustion.
Alex (SRE): action items: - Sachin: perform refill + routing now and post runbook commands (IN PROGRESS) - Sachin/Alex: propose autoscaler + headroom PR by EOD - Maria/Jess: customer comms + verify billing adjustments for failed requests - Ops: monitor for 1h and revert if unusual.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1642 assigned to Sachin. Priority: P2.
Sachin (Infra): refill + route done at 16:28 UTC. run: `rbctl` outputs: `refill ok`, `routing ok`. Monitoring shows queue dropped from 320 -> 40 within 4m, 429s stopped.
Maria (Support): told customer we applied emergency measures and they confirmed latency back to ~0.35s/token. customer accepted temporary credit and will patch their campaign to rate-limit spikes.
Alex (SRE): follow-ups: 1) PR to increase pool headroom to 25% and add soft per-tenant burst cap 2) add telemetry alert for 'burst_credits < 20% && queue > 100' 3) docs blurb for CS on when to offer emergency refill vs routing fallback
Jess (CS): will draft customer-facing summary and billing note. Maria, please include the refill command and timeline.
Maria (Support): adding final note to ticket: emergency refill performed, fallback routing enabled, autoscaler PR planned, customer to throttle campaign. closing provisional. :white_check_mark:
